question: For which of the following minerals are Jharia and Raniganj known?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Coal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jharia** and **Raniganj** are two prominent coalfields located in India.
 
• The **Jharia Coalfield** is situated in the **Dhanbad district of Jharkhand**, while the **Raniganj Coalfield** is located in **West Bengal**.
 
• These coalfields are rich in **bituminous coal**, which is a high-quality coal primarily used for **thermal power generation** and **industrial purposes.**
